name: Document Preview
description: Previews office and PDF documents in the browser by embedding the Google Docs viewer. Ships a file-field formatter with Simplebox (inline iframe) and Modal window display styles.
project_description: Document Preview renders office and PDF documents (pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, txt) inline in the browser by embedding the Google Docs viewer, so visitors can read a file without downloading it. It provides one core-file-field formatter, 'Document Preview Formatter' (id document_preview_formatter, extending FileFormatterBase), selectable per view display with two view types: 'Simplebox' (an inline iframe pointing at https://docs.google.com/viewer) and 'Modal window' (a use-ajax link that opens the document in a jQuery UI dialog via the document_preview.modal route, embedding https://docs.google.com/gview). The formatter only previews files stored on the public:// stream (Google must be able to reach the file); non-public files trigger an error message. Because rendering is delegated to Google's viewer, previews require publicly reachable file URLs and do not work on local-only environments. Depends only on Drupal core's Field and File modules.
